description: This file defines the SharedStorage class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It declares a plugin that implements shared storage functionality with notification mechanisms, remote connection handling, and interfaces for storage inspection, limits, and caching. The class includes nested notification classes and manages external dependencies via included interface headers.

classes.name: SharedStorage
classes.description: A plugin class implementing shared storage with notification and remote connection management, exposing interfaces for storage operations, inspection, limits, and cache.
